title: Growth config: MARKET_GROWTH
description: Per-market growth configuration (ARCH section 15). A new market is configuration plus data, never a code fork. Every default is PROPOSED_DEFAULT until the founder ratifies it (ARCH section 6.3 / 16). Unknown keys are rejected; secrets are never stored here, only secretRef names.

canonicalSegment.description: URL segment, lowercase cc, e.g. eg.

bookingLinkBaseUrl.description: Provider link host, e.g. https://kiorly.link (NEEDS_HUMAN, NH-008).

qrEnabled.description: Provider QR codes and posters on/off for this market. PROPOSED_DEFAULT True.

marketingLicenceConfirmed.description: Counsel confirmed the direct-marketing licence position for this market. PROPOSED_DEFAULT false; growth.marketing_messaging stays launch-locked regardless.

whatsappPhoneNumberIdRef.description: secretRef or config name of the WhatsApp phone number id; never the value.

integrations.description: Integration kind -> on/off; feature switches themselves stay in the flag control plane.

geographyListRef.description: Reference to the market-pack district list (NH-040/FD-14 open).

dataCell.description: Data cell id, e.g. frankfurt; one cell today.
